title: Price list
intro: Patients see these prices when they book and pay at the clinic. Nothing is charged in the app.
loadFailed: The price list could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
empty: The price list has no services yet.
name: Name
durationHint: Leave empty to use the length of the booked time.
vatHint: Leave empty for a service exempt from VAT.
activeHint: A service is never deleted. Turn this off to take it off the list. Receipts already issued keep it.
translations: Names for patients in other languages
translationsHint: Optional. A patient sees the name in their language where one is given.
invalidPrice: Enter a price such as 50 or 49.90.
invalidDuration: Enter a duration from 5 to 480 minutes, or leave it empty.
invalidVat: Enter a VAT rate from 0 to 100, or leave it empty.
invalidModes: Choose at least one way the service is offered.
invalidService: The service was not accepted. Check its fields and try again.
conflict: Someone else changed this service. Reload the page to see it, then make your change again.
forbidden: Only a clinic admin can change the price list.
saveFailed: The service could not be saved. Try again.
importHint: A CSV or XLSX file with a header row. Columns: name and price, and optionally code, duration (minutes), vat (%) and modes (in-person or video; empty is in-person). At most 1000 rows. The services are added as offered to patients.
importReady: {count, plural, one {# service read} other {# services read}}. Nothing is saved until you import.
importWrong: {count, plural, one {# of {total} rows has errors} other {# of {total} rows have errors}}. Correct them in the file and choose it again.
importNameInvalid: the name is longer than 200 characters
importCodeInvalid: the code is longer than 40 characters
importPriceInvalid: the price is not a valid amount
importDurationInvalid: the duration is not between 5 and 480 minutes
importVatInvalid: the VAT rate is not between 0 and 100 %
importModeInvalid: the modes are not in-person or video
importDuplicate: a service of this name or code is already on the list or the file
importUnreadable: The file could not be read. Use a CSV or XLSX file with a header row naming at least the name and price columns, and at most 1000 rows.
importFailed: The file could not be imported. Try again.
imported: {count, plural, one {# service imported.} other {# services imported.}}
